author: ojiudezue
title: v5.100.0 shipped: Device arrangement: Rooms grouping node (House -> Rooms -> Room) + sweep-counter re-arm + tuple-unpack safety + CM menu blank-rows labeled
summary: Device arrangement: Rooms grouping node (House -> Rooms -> Room) + sweep-counter re-arm + tuple-unpack safety + CM menu blank-rows labeled
why: Operator looked at the integration arrangement and saw only the reload suppression shipped — the visual-tree reorg (#1) and menu cleanup (#4) were drawn/carded but not built (the finish-the-job miss). This ships them: the Rooms grouping node makes the device tree symmetric (House->Rooms->Room like House->Coordinators->Coordinator), plus the two carded device-tree prereqs (sweep re-arm, tuple-unpack). Built as pure via_device + one node (no ownership migration, no integration reload) to stay off the v5.94.x device-registry hazard and the reload-outage path. The Tier-2DB review battery caught 2 CRITICALs the build missed: the entity-less integration-owned Rooms node matched BOTH the shell-cleanup deletion predicate (would orphan all 40 rooms every boot) and the stamper's empty-shell parent-exclusion (inert node) — fixed with a shared _GROUPING_NODE_IDS exemption, real-registry mutation-anchored tests, orchestrator re-verified the room-orphaning drill. D4 selector polish carded (CM-CONFIG-FLOW-UX-SELECTORS-1) as a risk-divergent follow-up (RestoreEntity). Verified 5.100 is HACS-safe before choosing the version.
implications: Shipped URA-INTEGRATION-ARRANGEMENT-1, DEVICE-TREE-SWEEP-COUNTER-LIFETIME-LATCH-1, DEVICE-TREE-TUPLE-UNPACK-CONSISTENCY-1, CM-CONFIG-FLOW-UX-1 at v5.100.0; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.100.0.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: After restart + CM reload, device (universal_room_automation,rooms) 'URA: Rooms' EXISTS in the registry (not deleted by shell-cleanup) AND rooms' via_device_id -> Rooms -> integration (House->Rooms->Room), no orphaned rooms, no INV-4 sweep WARN; query device registry at disposition

refs.release_notes: D3 adds an INTEGRATION-owned Rooms grouping device so rooms nest House->Rooms->Room (was flat off House), via imperative via_device D-NEST sweep — pure display-nesting, no ownership migration, no integration reload. D1 re-arms the parent-link sweep (resets on residual==0) so late rooms nest. D2 makes two device.identifiers loops 3-tuple-safe. D4 labels the 2 blank CM options rows (translation-only). First 5.100 release — HACS awesomeversion sorts it fine (same lib as HA CalVer 2024.10>2024.9); 6.0.0 stays for the identity milestone.
